required_concepts: number divisible by 6 is also divisible by 3
acceptable_paraphrases: The number 6 is a multiple of 3
Every multiple of 6 is automatically a multiple of 3 because 3 is one of the factors of 6
Because six is two times of 3
Because 3 is a prime factor of 6
Every Number Divisible by 6 can be Divisible by 3 because 6 is a number that is divisible by 3
Because 3 time 2 is six so it the same number
Because 6 is a factor of 2 and 3
misconceptions: If the number is divisible by either 2 or 3, it is divisible by 6
Because 6 is a factor of 2 and 3
Because 6 is divisible by 3 and 3 is less
It has to be divisible by 2, 3
grading_notes: Students should understand that the number 6 being composed of factors 2 and 3 supports their explanation. Avoiding misconceptions related to divisibility rules will ensure a clear understanding.
